_nota: Traducciones al inglés. Clave = texto exacto en español (de content/servicios.json o content/proyectos.json); valor = texto en inglés. Si falta una clave, ese texto sale en español en la versión inglesa: python herramientas/genera.py avisa de las que faltan. 'iguales' = nombres propios que no se traducen (para que el script no avise).

textos.Identidades que se reconocen, piezas que: Identities people recognise, pieces that read at a glance and websites that work.
textos.Diseñamos el espacio y lo enseñamos en 3: We design the space and show it in 3D before anything gets built.
textos.Del render al objeto: modelos revisados: From render to object: models checked and ready to print.
textos.Montamos el material para que se vea ent: We cut the footage so people watch it to the end, on social or on a big screen.
textos.Estrategia y contenido para que la marca: Strategy and content so the brand has something to say every week.
textos.Asistentes que responden a vuestros clie: Assistants that answer your customers in the brand's own voice.
textos.Diseño del evento corporativo celebrado: Design of the corporate event held in Valencia to recognise energy and social-impact organisations and initiatives for their contribution to the area after the DANA floods.
textos.Evento en Barcelona para presentar las n: An event in Barcelona presenting the new collections to content creators: a branded space built for discovering the product, mingling and shooting.
textos.Una de las primeras grandes activaciones: One of the brand's first major activations in Spain. We took its laboratory aesthetic into the space: clinical, minimal and entirely white, from the overall design to the last detail.
textos.Intervenciones de marca en clubs nocturn: Brand installations in nightclubs: illuminated elements, premium materials and architectural details that fit in without taking over the venue's identity.
textos.Serie de intervenciones en clubs nocturn: A series of nightclub installations bringing the brand's clean, sophisticated aesthetic into the space: an elegant, discreet presence that leaves the venue's atmosphere intact.
textos.Dos eventos en las salas del Cine Callao: Two events in the halls of Cine Callao and two opposite moods: a dynamic, tech-driven language for Logiplay 2025 and a warm, sophisticated stage for Rioja's centenary.
textos.Stands de líneas limpias e iluminación p: Stands with clean lines and precise lighting, designed to draw people in within seconds in crowded halls and let the brand read fast. Various clients.
textos.Propuestas para exterior que tratan la l: Outdoor proposals that treat light, weather and footfall as living variables: lightweight structures, honest materials and lighting that follows the rhythm of the day. Various clients.
textos.Escenografías, activaciones y eventos de: Set designs, activations and events at different scales. Temporary architecture, lighting and graphics work together so the space supports the occasion without stealing the show. Various clients.
textos.Colección de merchandising para Beach Ho: A merchandise collection for Beach House Ibiza: the twelve zodiac signs drawn as star charts, as a series of prints and applied to a T-shirt, tote bag and scarf.
textos.Identidad para un club que quería ser un: An identity for a club that wanted to be a place to meet, not just another nightclub.
textos.Un antiguo almacén de 900 m² y un sector: A former 900 m² warehouse and a scene full of clubs that all look alike. The founders wanted people to come for the music and for each other.
textos.Convertimos el nombre en la idea: un pun: We turned the name into the idea: a red dot that closes the logo, lights the façade, marks the DJ booth and ends every message. Direct and unadorned. Full stop.
textos.El punto final mide lo mismo que la altu: The full stop is exactly as tall as the x-height: a dot and a symbol at once.
textos.Versiones sobre rojo, apilada y el sello: Versions on red, stacked, and the seal, used on stickers, the avatar and the entry stamp.
textos.Merchandising: bolsa de tela, mecheros,: Merchandise: tote bag, lighters, entry wristbands, coasters, badge and matchbox.
textos.Recursos gráficos: entre muchos puntos a: Graphic devices: one lit dot among many unlit ones (the meeting point), the dot as a window for photography, and short lines that always end in a full stop.
textos.Carteles de la primera semana, para call: Opening-week posters for street and social. Each night gets its own colour and letter width.
textos.Logo en movimiento: cortes secos a cada: Logo in motion: hard cuts on every half beat, like a VJ's visuals. The logo, single words at full screen, the dot hitting the beat, rows running in opposite directions and strobe flashes. A four-bar loop that follows the tempo of the set.
textos.Punto disco: el punto parpadea rápido en: Disco dot: the dot flickers fast through dance-floor colours and settles on red. A separate piece for announcing special nights and for the venue's screens.
textos.Web: la agenda es la portada. Cada noche: Web: the line-up is the home page. Each night takes one line and tickets are two taps away on mobile.
textos.Identidad, redes sociales, merchandising: Identity, social media, merchandise and a website with an online shop for a boutique pilates studio.
textos.Web para un estudio de diseño y construc: A website for a design-build studio that renovates South Florida homes in a Mediterranean style, built to rank in search engines and in AI assistants' answers.
textos.La web, navegable: se puede recorrer ent: The live website: scroll through it and drag the before-and-after sliders.
textos.Un asistente por chat que reserva citas: A chat assistant that books appointments straight into the clinic's real calendar and, after the visit, collects the patient's review.
textos.Web profesional para una doctora y consu: A professional website for a physician and consultant in ozone therapy and integrative medicine: an introduction, her career and a searchable library of publications, in Spanish and English.
textos.La web, navegable: tres páginas, dos idi: The live website: three pages, two languages and a publication search.
